case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

You were open about labour weighing heavily on your costs, and we take that seriously. Our options give you a longer contract term, so you can plan your foundry workforce with more certainty.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.39; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-01-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 46.25; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.64; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Option A is the package we can approve: it keeps your standard payment term and secures a longer contract term for your wages-driven cost base.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We appreciate the transparency of your offer and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your focus on a longer partnership and are pleased to accept the 24-month contract term and the 1 January 2027 start date from your Option A. With this extended planning security for our foundry, we can reduce our price to €51.40 per unit. 

For our Angebot, we propose a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. 

As your proposed price is significantly lower than our calculations, please share the data behind your target so we can understand your position. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your revised options and are willing to accept the 1 February 2027 start date from your Option B. In exchange for this adjustment, we can lower our price to €50.90 per unit.

For our traditional family-run foundry, maintaining a strong partnership across our region is deeply important to us. Under our updated offer, we provide a price of €50.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

As you have not provided the data behind your target price, we must again ask you to share the basis of your calculations. We value our long relationship and look forward to your response.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
